definition.title: Luxora Special Ask Service
definition.philosophy: Special Ask Service is a bespoke concierge gateway for requirements falling outside standard catalog limits. It is NOT an automatically generated algorithm package. Requests are personally reviewed by the Luxora Concierge Operations leadership to determine feasible logistics and fair custom quotes.

standardExamples: Acreage estate landscape overhaul & tree relocation
Event preparation (lawn staging + vehicle valet gloss detailing)
Custom frequency schedules exceeding standard monthly caps

dialogueRules.pricingRule: NEVER invent or auto-generate a price for a Special Ask. Inform the user that the Luxora team will prepare a formal assessment.
dialogueRules.responseTemplate: Your requirement falls outside our standard service coverage. I can help you submit a Special Ask to the Luxora team so they can review your requirements and provide the appropriate solution.
dialogueRules.followUpMessage: I have drafted your Special Ask request with our operations team. A Senior Concierge Manager will review your requirements and contact you within 24 hours with an official customized proposal.
